title: Logical AI OS: A Training-Free Governance Layer Outside the Model for Instruction Following -- Benefits, Costs, Failures, and the Calibration of the Measuring Instrument Itself
abstract: arXiv:2611.19767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models often fail explicit user requests (length, number of items, format, required or forbidden words, grammatical person, answer language). We measure a training-free governance layer placed outside the model: it reads the requests with rules, checks the answer mechanically, repairs it when a request is not kept, and hands back the original answer when the repair fails. The loop exists in prior work; our contribution is measuring its benefits, costs and failures, and reporting how the measuring instrument itself was calibrated. On four 4-bit Qwen-family models (3B, 7B, 14B, one 7B reasoning model) and 329 Chinese prompts: (1) answers that keep every request the layer read rise significantly (all comparisons p<0.0001), by 34 to 66 of 329 under the corrected checker and 52 to 92 after a length-control fix; a generic redo message brings no significant gain. (2) Exploratory: on 90 repair-triggered prompts, two AI annotators

translated_title: 逻辑AI操作系统：模型之外的免训练指令遵循治理层——收益、成本、失败及测量工具本身的校准
translated_abstract: 小语言模型经常无法满足用户的显式要求（长度、条目数量、格式、必需或禁止的词、语法人称、答案语言）。我们测量了一个置于模型之外的免训练治理层：它用规则读取请求，机械地检查答案，当请求未被遵守时进行修复，当修复失败时返回原始答案。该循环在先前的工作中已经存在；我们的贡献在于测量其收益、成本和失败情况，并报告测量工具本身是如何被校准的。在四个4位量化的Qwen系列模型（3B、7B、14B、一个7B推理模型）和329个中文提示词上：(1) 完全遵守该层所读取的每一项要求的答案显著增加（所有比较p<0.0001），在校正后的检查器下，329个提示词中增加34至66个，在长度控制修复后增加52至92个；通用的重做消息未带来显著收益。(2) 探索性结果：在90个触发修复的提示词上，两个AI标注者……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在模型外部部署了一个免训练的治理层来强制小语言模型遵循用户显式指令，显著提升了指令遵守率，并系统测量了其收益、成本、失败模式以及测量工具自身的校准过程。
en_tdlr: This paper measures a training-free governance layer outside small language models that enforces explicit instruction following, significantly improving compliance rates while reporting the benefits, costs, failures, and the calibration of the measuring instrument itself.
